page.title: Lord Aethelstan
page.subtitle: Enter the castle.
page.heroDescription: Step into Lord Aethelstan’s realm, where the haunting beauty of Gothic castles is captured in a cathedral PC case with striking stained glass panels. Castles and gaming PCs may seem as different as two things come, but that’s what makes the combination so magical. And the detailed side panels are UV printed directly onto the surface, creating rich color and sharp detail that won’t peel, fade, or scratch with normal use.
page.about: The haunting allure of Gothic castles is embodied in a PC that transcends mere machinery, with its captivating stained glass panels casting an enchanting ambience over your setup. Elevate your gaming experience to regal heights with this truly captivating masterpiece…your lord commands it.

content.title: Watchful Wolf
content.description: In homage to the lord himself, a majestic wolf head gracefully adorns the UV printed stained glass design.

content.title: Gothic Allure
content.description: Gothic spirit flourishes as hues of crimson, black and grey intertwine in a mesmerizing display designed to envelop your hardware and allow your components to peak through in key places.

content.title: RETIRED: White Wolf Edition
content.description: Behold Lord Aethelstan: White Wolf Edition. With a lighter, almost celestial aesthetic, this captivating variant breathes new life into the beloved Lord Aethelstan design while retaining its unmistakable Gothic spirit.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
